title: feat(app-shell,i18n): Home's Recently accessed lists records and list views with an object · app · time trail, beside the activity feed (objectui#12604)
body:
Fixes #12604
Clause-②: yes

## Summary

Section 4 of the approved home artboard (系统首页 · 四段式): "Recently accessed" beside "Activity feed".

- **Store** (`RecentItemsProvider`, the one the sidebar and the command palette already read). It keeps the last 20 entries instead of 8, deduped by target: one per record, one per object view. A named list view is recorded as its own kind, `view`, stored by identity (its object and its view name, both required, no display text) and labelled when it is drawn, in the current language. `RecentItemType`, exported from the package entry, gains the `view` member.
- **Visit calls.** The record page already recorded the record (`RecordDetailView`); it is unchanged and now pinned. List pages record through `useTrackRouteAsRecent`, which `AppContent` runs on every route. A `/apps/APP/OBJECT/view/VIEW` route now records the view. The object's own entry comes only from the object's list routes (its bare route and its data surface). Before, every route under an object also recorded the object, so each record opened on HotCRM pushed "Accounts" into the list beside it.
- **Recently accessed** (`HomeContinue`). A 15 px / 600 heading above a bordered card. Up to six 40 px rows, newest first. Each row has a 24 px kind icon tile (a record takes its object's icon; dashboard, list view, page and object take theirs), the 13 px title, and a 12 px muted trail: the record's object label (or the kind), the app the entry was opened in, and the visit time through `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` in the display locale.
- **Activity feed** (`HomeActivity`). A heading above a card with 12 px padding. Each row shows the actor (13 px / 500), then the change muted, then a 12 px line with the time and object. "View all activity" is the last row. The column still renders only for a caller who may read `sys_activity`, and without it the recent block spans the full width (pinned).

## Premise check

The card says records and list views are not recorded. On current main, records were recorded and shown, and object lists were too. The real gaps were that a named list view collapsed into its object's entry, and that rows had no trail and no object icon. Both are fixed here. The live run also exposed the record-route object entry described above.

## Deviations

- The empty line keeps the existing key `home.continueEmpty` ("Items you open will show up here." / "你打开过的内容会显示在这里。"). The claim allows new locale keys only, so I did not change it to the artboard's wording.
- Two existing pins changed on purpose. The cap went from 8 to 20. The objectui#11678 pin "an object's list route and its view route are one visit" now reads: a view is its own target; revisiting it still writes nothing.
- Outside the claimed files: `useRecentItemLabel.ts` (labels the new kind for every surface, the sidebar included), and `appLastOpened.ts` (exports its existing app-segment reader so the trail and the tiles read the app the same way).
- Merged main after objectui#12602 landed. In `HomeRail.tsx` and `HomePage.tsx` I kept both sides. `Card` and `Row` were used only by the old recent and activity cards and are removed with them.

## Measurements: HotCRM at 1280 px after opening two records, one list view and one dashboard

Read from the DOM at capture, in light and dark (identical). Rows are 40 px. Recent column 736 px, activity column 360 px, gap 24 px. Headings computed at 15px / 600.

| # | kind (icon) | title | trail (en) | trail (zh-CN) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | record (building, the Account object's icon) | ACC-000001 - Acme Corporation | Account · HotCRM · 1 minute ago | 客户 · HotCRM · 2分钟前 |
| 2 | dashboard | Executive Overview / 高管总览 | Dashboard · HotCRM · 1 minute ago | 仪表盘 · HotCRM · 2分钟前 |
| 3 | view (list) | Account Cards / 客户卡片 | List view · HotCRM · 2 minutes ago | 列表视图 · HotCRM · 3分钟前 |
| 4 | record (building) | ACC-000003 - Initech Solutions | Account · HotCRM · 2 minutes ago | 客户 · HotCRM · 3分钟前 |

The sidebar's Recent group on the same session lists Executive Overview, ACC-000001 - Acme Corporation, Account Cards and ACC-000003 - Initech Solutions, each linking to its own address.

## Tests

All at `94f4369`.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, full, foreground: 1453 files passed, 1 skipped; 13726 tests passed, 9 skipped; exit 0.
- New pins:
  - `HomePage.recentlyAccessed-12604.test.tsx`: newest first, at most six, kind icon (a record takes its object's), trail of context · app · time in the display locale, full width without `sys_activity` plus a control with it.
  - `RecordDetailView.recordsRecentVisit-12604.test.tsx`: opening a record page records the record with its title, object and app.
  - `useTrackRouteAsRecent.test.tsx`: opening a list view records it; record, create and edit routes do not record the object.
  - `RecentItemsProvider.test.tsx`: at most 20, one entry per record and per view, a view stored by identity.
  - `useRecentItemLabel.test.tsx`: view label, with the object fallback.
  - `UnifiedSidebar.recentRecordsAndViews-12604.test.tsx`: the sidebar's Recent list still renders with record and view entries.
- Ten one-time ablations through `ablation-replace.mjs`, each red, each restored with `git diff HEAD` empty: cap back to 8, dedupe removed, view branch disabled, record-route guard forced, app dropped from the trail, record icon dropped, activity grid gate removed, order reversed, view label returning the raw name, record page's visit call removed.
- Also exit 0:
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`, the i18n and app-shell builds, eslint on every changed file.
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`.
  - `check-changeset-presence`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-control-bytes`.

## Acceptance notes

- `RecentItemType` gains `view`. A `view` entry carries `object` and `name` rather than a `label`, so code that switches over every kind must handle it. The changeset says so.
- A saved user view the metadata cache does not hold is titled with its object's list title, never its raw name.
- Each of the ten language packs gains `home.recentApps.itemType.view`.
